# CompliancePreflightOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Selects which rule families run. It never changes how a rule that does run behaves, so a filtered report is always a subset of the unfiltered one.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new CompliancePreflightOptions()
```

## Properties

- [`IncludeWcag`](#includewcag): Run the WCAG 2.2 contrast rules ("contrast-insufficient", "contrast-unknown").

### `IncludeWcag`

```csharp
bool IncludeWcag { get; set; }
```

Run the WCAG 2.2 contrast rules ("contrast-insufficient", "contrast-unknown"). Defaults to `true`.

With `false` those findings are absent from `Findings`and from the counts, as if the document had no contrast problems; the PDF/UA-1 rules are untouched, and `Passed` cannot change because no WCAG rule emits an error.

The two families answer different questions — PDF/UA-1 findings are conformance to a claim the document makes, contrast is an adjacent standard an author may be tracking separately — and on a colour-rich document the contrast findings can bury the structural ones.
